biggest_catch: The $250–$500 is a state contribution added to your 529 account — savings on planned college saving, not cash in hand. And receiving a state contribution in a given year makes you INELIGIBLE for Maryland's income-subtraction tax break on your own contributions that year, which can offset part of the benefit.
catches: Savings, not income: the state contribution goes into the 529 account — it is a boost to planned college savings, not spendable cash.

Income-banded: individual AGI $49,999 or less (joint $74,999 or less) contributing $25+ gets $500; individual $50,000–$87,499 (joint $75,000–$124,999) contributing $100+ gets $500; individual $87,500–$112,500 (joint $125,000–$175,000) contributing $250+ gets $250. Over the cap = ineligible.
Receiving a state contribution in a year forfeits the Maryland income subtraction (up to $2,500/year/beneficiary) on your own contributions that year — the net benefit is smaller than the headline.
Application deadline: 11:59 pm ET May 31; the minimum contribution must be made by 11:59 pm ET November 1 of the application year. Miss either and you get nothing.
Beneficiary must be a Maryland resident under age 26 in the calendar year before application; account must have been opened after December 31, 2016.
One application per account owner/beneficiary relationship; a beneficiary may receive only two state contributions in any year; prior $9,000 in state contributions = ineligible.
Subject to changes by the Maryland General Assembly — the legislature can alter or end the program.
Standard 529 tax risk: non-qualified withdrawals face federal income tax plus a 10% federal penalty on earnings (and Maryland may recapture deductions) — consult a tax professional.

steps: Open a Maryland College Investment Plan 529 account if you don't have one (must be an account opened after December 31, 2016).
Check your AGI against the official table to find your band and minimum contribution ($25 for $500, $100 for $500, or $250 for $250).
Submit the Save4College State Contribution Program application by 11:59 pm ET on May 31.
Make at least the band's minimum contribution to the applied-for account by 11:59 pm ET on November 1 of the application year.
